root.title: Si_PRX_GAP: A foundational Density Functional Theory dataset with silicon configurations for training machine learning interatomic potentials
root.description: The original DFT training data for the general-purpose silicon interatomic potential described in the associated publication. The kinds of configuration that were included were selected based on intuition and past experience to obtain good coverage pertaining to a range of properties.

material-component.description: A variety of Si configurations including different phases, surfaces, vacancies, interstitials, dislocations and crack tips.
